KeptAsking.description: A reference to a kept answer file or an identified input within an accumulated file. Model and prompt metadata can come from a companion trial setting or history; fields absent from storage are not invented. This is not a promise that one file is one paid call. Payloads retain their existing steps formats.

fields.description: The kept answer's file path relative to the steps repository. The path locates an existing payload; it is not that payload or a public download URI.
fields.name: answer_file

shape.description: The kept answer's file path relative to the steps repository. The path locates an existing payload; it is not that payload or a public download URI.

fields.description: The cost in US dollars where kept, including zero. It retains the stored file's accounting scope: English and Latin accumulate calls, and structure may include retries. Do not sum the same file's cost again for every input or interpret it as a measured per-call cost. Omit when unavailable.
fields.name: cost_usd

shape.description: The cost in US dollars where kept, including zero. It retains the stored file's accounting scope: English and Latin accumulate calls, and structure may include retries. Do not sum the same file's cost again for every input or interpret it as a measured per-call cost. Omit when unavailable.

fields.description: An asking day where actually kept: English answered_on for the indexed input or the trial directory's day. Omit when unknown; a first committed day is not an observed asking day and must not be silently substituted.
fields.name: day

shape.description: An asking day where actually kept: English answered_on for the indexed input or the trial directory's day. Omit when unknown; a first committed day is not an observed asking day and must not be silently substituted.

fields.description: An input fingerprint where kept: English pieces keys are xxh3_64 text digests; structure and joining request values are truncated SHA-256 fingerprints of whole requests. Structure trials also keep request and sent fingerprints with different scopes; an index must choose and document its input scope. Latin request is a prompt code, not an input fingerprint. Omit when no input fingerprint was kept, including trial rows.
fields.name: input_fingerprint

shape.description: An input fingerprint where kept: English pieces keys are xxh3_64 text digests; structure and joining request values are truncated SHA-256 fingerprints of whole requests. Structure trials also keep request and sent fingerprints with different scopes; an index must choose and document its input scope. Latin request is a prompt code, not an input fingerprint. Omit when no input fingerprint was kept, including trial rows.

fields.description: The stored model selector, or the companion setting's model for trial rows.
fields.name: model

shape.description: The stored model selector, or the companion setting's model for trial rows.

fields.description: The associated PromptVersion.code, resolved by steps from the stored prompt code, companion setting or recovered history. English stores the code as prompt and Latin as request. Structure and joining request values include inputs; their association requires recovery, not an assumption that they hash only instructions. A recovered version may retain a whole-request code.
fields.name: prompt_code

shape.description: The associated PromptVersion.code, resolved by steps from the stored prompt code, companion setting or recovered history. English stores the code as prompt and Latin as request. Structure and joining request values include inputs; their association requires recovery, not an assumption that they hash only instructions. A recovered version may retain a whole-request code.

KeptAsking.yaml:
KeptAsking:
    description: >-
      A reference to a kept answer file or an identified input within an accumulated
      file. Model and prompt metadata can come from a companion trial setting or
      history; fields absent from storage are not invented. This is not a promise
      that one file is one paid call. Payloads retain their existing steps formats.
    see_also:
      - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#Activity
      - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#Entity
    comments:
      - >-
        PROV-O Activity corresponds to the asking described, and Entity to the
        kept file. Accumulated files need their own usage and generation history.
    attributes:
      prompt_code:
        range: ExchangeCode
        required: true
        description: >-
          The associated PromptVersion.code, resolved by steps from the stored
          prompt code, companion setting or recovered history. English stores the
          code as prompt and Latin as request. Structure and joining request values
          include inputs; their association requires recovery, not an assumption that
          they hash only instructions. A recovered version may retain a whole-request code.
        annotations:
          references: PromptVersion.code
        see_also:
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#hadPlan
        comments:
          - >-
            A PROV-O plan link would pass through the asking's qualified association;
            hadPlan is not a direct Activity property.
      model:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The stored model selector, or the companion setting's model for trial rows.
        see_also:
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#SoftwareAgent
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#wasAssociatedWith
      day:
        range: ExchangeDay
        description: >-
          An asking day where actually kept: English answered_on for the indexed input
          or the trial directory's day. Omit when unknown; a first committed day is
          not an observed asking day and must not be silently substituted.
        see_also:
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#endedAtTime
        comments:
          - >-
            This day has less precision than the PROV-O timestamp property.
      input_fingerprint:
        range: ExchangeCode
        description: >-
          An input fingerprint where kept: English pieces keys are xxh3_64 text
          digests; structure and joining request values are truncated SHA-256
          fingerprints of whole requests. Structure trials also keep request and
          sent fingerprints with different scopes; an index must choose and document
          its input scope. Latin request is a prompt code, not an input fingerprint.
          Omit when no input fingerprint was kept, including trial rows.
        see_also:
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#used
      answer_file:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The kept answer's file path relative to the steps repository. The path
          locates an existing payload; it is not that payload or a public download URI.
        see_also:
          - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#generated
      cost_usd:
        range: NonNegativeNumber
        description: >-
          The cost in US dollars where kept, including zero. It retains the stored
          file's accounting scope: English and Latin accumulate calls, and structure
          may include retries. Do not sum the same file's cost again for every input
          or interpret it as a measured per-call cost. Omit when unavailable.

PromptVersion.yaml:
PromptVersion:
    tree_root: true
    description: >-
      One prompt version's metadata, kept beside its exact text and recovered answer
      shape. First and last refer to its presence in code history, not paid-call dates.
      A shape may be unrecoverable even when the prompt text and its history are known.
    see_also:
      - https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#Plan
    comments:
      - >-
        PROV-O Plan is a useful correspondence for versioned instructions. These
        metadata do not assert an RDF type or establish a plan's execution.
    attributes:
      code:
        range: ExchangeCode
        required: true
        description: >-
          The sixteen-character code naming this stored version and its directory.
          Some historical codes cover an expanded whole request rather than only
          instructions; the steps registry must establish the recipe and scope.
      asking:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The asking served by these instructions, such as find_items, read_latin,
          write_english or join_people. Trial variants are registered by steps;
          this field is not a new controlled vocabulary.
      model:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The model selector used with this version. It is recorded configuration,
          not an assertion that two selectors denote the same model release.
      effort:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The explicit effort setting when known; omit when no setting was supplied
          or recovered. Model-dependent effort values are not enumerated here.
      budget_usd:
        range: NonNegativeNumber
        required: true
        description: >-
          The configured maximum budget in US dollars, separate from an answer's
          recorded cost. Zero is allowed; no undocumented upper bound is imposed.
      shape_name:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The answer shape's name, qualified by its module when needed. Knowing
          this name does not imply that the exact schema bytes were recovered.
      first_commit:
        range: ExchangeCommit
        required: true
        description: >-
          The first steps commit known to contain this prompt version in code.
      first_day:
        range: ExchangeDay
        required: true
        description: >-
          The day of first_commit, as established by steps' history recovery.
      last_commit:
        range: ExchangeCommit
        required: true
        description: >-
          The last steps commit known to contain this prompt version in code, not
          necessarily the latest kept answer or the commit removing the version.
      last_day:
        range: ExchangeDay
        required: true
        description: >-
          The day of last_commit. Agreement with history and first_day ordering
          are checked in steps, not by this single-document shape.
      shape_recovered:
        range: boolean
        required: true
        description: >-
          Whether the exact answer JSON Schema was recovered reproducibly and kept
          beside the prompt. False explicitly records the limit on answer validation;
          a shape name by itself is not recovery.

ExchangeCode.description: Exactly sixteen lowercase hexadecimal characters. Prompt codes and the stored short input fingerprints share this lexical form; it does not identify the hash algorithm or what is covered. The steps registry owns the byte-level rule.

ExchangeCommit.description: A full forty-character Git SHA-1 commit id in the steps repository, not an abbreviated id, branch or a claim that this commit exists in the schema repository.

ExchangeDay.description: A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, with JSON Schema date format validation enabled by the consumer. No time of day or timezone is inferred.
